title: Quillen's Conjecture on Posets of Elementary Abelian p-Subgroups
exact_target: If the complex of nontrivial elementary abelian p-subgroups contracts to a point, must the group contain a nontrivial normal p-subgroup?

sources.citation: A. Díaz Ramos, N. Mazza, A geometric approach to Quillen's conjecture, accepted manuscript, Lancaster University EPrints 158837.
